extraction.notes: Three-month column for Q3 2026 taken from the FFO reconciliation (seq 11, printed page 7; duplicated on seq 16, printed S-3). Company reports no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Share count printed as 66,495,937 and divided by 1,000 to match thousands units; check: 264,693/66,495.937 = 3.98 and 266,201/66,495.937 = 4.00. The 'Depreciation attributable to third party ownership and other' line (-39) was categorized as re_depreciation as it adjusts depreciation; this is a judgment call. The G&A and other line (1,504) includes political advocacy costs of $0.3 million and is categorized as 'other' per the company's footnote; it is not separately identified as legal in the current quarter. Zero-value lines (expensed acquisition costs, provision for credit losses, loss on early retirement of debt, income from early redemption of preferred equity) were included at 0. Starting-line page_printed is blank because the marker has no printed number.
